spin_geff_analysis.interpretation: Spin adds ε_spin ≈ 2(v_tan/c)sin²θ/Rindler on the same outside slot as ε_grav = GM/(Rc²). That raises (1+ε)^α in the nuclear G_eff modulator. Separately, flyby G_eff uses (φ/φ_ref)^α with geometric φ (not spin); spin feeds φ_eff via 6aε and screens orbital G_eff through the inertia factor.
